title: vercel-labs/json-render
title_zh: json-render是一个生成性UI框架：AI根据您定义的组件从自然语言提示中生成界面。您设定界限，AI在界限内生成：

paragraphs.en: Generate dynamic, personalized UIs from prompts without sacrificing reliability. Predefined components and actions for safe, predictable output.
paragraphs.zh: 通过提示词生成动态、个性化的界面，同时不牺牲可靠性。 预定义的组件与操作，确保安全、可预测的输出。

sents.en: Generate dynamic, personalized UIs from prompts without sacrificing reliability.
sents.zh: 通过提示词生成动态、个性化的界面，同时不牺牲可靠性。

sents.en: Predefined components and actions for safe, predictable output.
sents.zh: 预定义的组件与操作，确保安全、可预测的输出。

paragraphs.en: # for React npm install @json-render/core @json-render/react # for React with pre-built shadcn/ui components npm install @json-render/shadcn # or for React Native npm install @json-render/core @json-render/react-native # or for video npm install @json-render/core @json-render/remotion # or for PDF documents npm install @json-render/core @json-render/react-pdf # or for HTML email npm install @json-render/core @json-render/react-email @react-email/components @react-email/render # or for Vue npm install @json-render/core @json-render/vue # or for Svelte npm install @json-render/core @json-render/svelte # or for SolidJS npm install @json-render/core @json-render/solid # or for terminal UIs npm install @json-render/core @json-render/ink ink react # or for full Next.js apps (routes, layouts, SSR, metadata) npm install @json-render/core @json-render/react @json-render/next # or for 3D scenes (and gaussian splatting via the GaussianSplat component) npm install @json-render/core @json-render/react-three-fiber @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three Why json-render? json-render is a Generative UI framework: AI generates interfaces from natural language prompts, constrained to components you define. You set the guardrails, AI generates within them:

```tsx
import { defineCatalog } from "@json-render/core" ; import { schema , standardComponentDefinitions , standardActionDefinitions , defineRegistry , Renderer , JSONUIProvider , } from "@json-render/ink" ; const catalog = defineCatalog ( schema , { components : { ... standardComponentDefinitions } , actions : standardActionDefinitions , } ) ; const { registry } = defineRegistry ( catalog , { components : { } } ) ; const spec = { root : "card-1" , elements : { "card-1" : { type : "Card" , props : { title : "Status" } , children : [ "status-1" ] , } , "status-1" : { type : "StatusLine" , props : { label : "Build" , status : "success" } , children : [ ] , } , } , } ; < JSONUIProvider initialState = { { } } > < Renderer spec = { spec } registry = { registry } /> </ JSONUIProvider > ; Features Streaming (SpecStream) Stream AI responses progressively:
```

功能 流式传输（SpecStream）逐步流式输出 AI 响应：

paragraphs.en: import { createSpecStreamCompiler } from "@json-render/core" ; const compiler = createSpecStreamCompiler < MySpec > ( ) ; // Process chunks as they arrive const { result , newPatches } = compiler . push ( chunk ) ; setSpec ( result ) ; // Update UI with partial result // Get final result const finalSpec = compiler . getResult ( ) ; AI Prompt Generation Generate system prompts from your catalog:

const systemPrompt = catalog . prompt ( ) ; // Includes component descriptions, props schemas, available actions Conditional Visibility { "type" : " Alert " , "props" : { "message" : " Error occurred " }, "visible" : [ { "$state" : " /form/hasError " }, { "$state" : " /form/errorDismissed " , "not" : true } ] } Dynamic Props Any prop value can be data-driven using expressions:
paragraphs.zh:
```
const systemPrompt = catalog . prompt ( ) ; // 包含组件描述、props 模式、可用操作
```

条件可见性

```json
{
  "type" : " Alert " ,
  "props" : { "message" : " Error occurred " },
  "visible" : [ { "$state" : " /form/hasError " },
                { "$state" : " /form/errorDismissed " , "not" : true } ]
}
```

动态 Props

任何 prop 值都可以通过表达式进行数据驱动：

paragraphs.en: { "type" : " Icon " , "props" : { "name" : { "$cond" : { "$state" : " /activeTab " , "eq" : " home " }, "$then" : " home " , "$else" : " home-outline " }, "color" : { "$cond" : { "$state" : " /activeTab " , "eq" : " home " }, "$then" : " #007AFF " , "$else" : " #8E8E93 " } } } Expression forms:
paragraphs.zh: { "type" : " Icon " , "props" : { "name" : { "$cond" : { "$state" : " /activeTab " , "eq" : " home " }, "$then" : " home " , "$else" : " home-outline " }, "color" : { "$cond" : { "$state" : " /activeTab " , "eq" : " home " }, "$then" : " #007AFF " , "$else" : " #8E8E93 " } } } 表达式形式：

paragraphs.en: Components can trigger actions, including the built-in setState action:
paragraphs.zh: 组件可以触发操作，包括内置的 setState 操作：

paragraphs.en: { "type" : " Pressable " , "props" : { "action" : " setState " , "actionParams" : { "statePath" : " /activeTab " , "value" : " home " } }, "children" : [ " home-icon " ] } The setState action updates the state model directly, which re-evaluates visibility conditions and dynamic prop expressions.
paragraphs.zh: { "type" : " Pressable " , "props" : { "action" : " setState " , "actionParams" : { "statePath" : " /activeTab " , "value" : " home " } }, "children" : [ " home-icon " ] } setState 动作直接更新状态模型，从而重新评估可见性条件和动态属性表达式。

paragraphs.en: React to state changes by triggering actions:
paragraphs.zh: 通过触发操作来响应状态变化：

paragraphs.en: { "type" : " Select " , "props" : { "value" : { "$bindState" : " /form/country " }, "options" : [ " US " , " Canada " , " UK " ] }, "watch" : { "/form/country" : { "action" : " loadCities " , "params" : { "country" : { "$state" : " /form/country " } } } } } watch is a top-level field on elements (sibling of type / props / children ). Watchers fire when the watched value changes, not on initial render.
paragraphs.zh: { "type" : " Select " , "props" : { "value" : { "$bindState" : " /form/country " }, "options" : [ " US " , " Canada " , " UK " ] }, "watch" : { "/form/country" : { "action" : " loadCities " , "params" : { "country" : { "$state" : " /form/country " } } } } } watch 是元素上的一个顶层字段（与 type / props / children 平级）。 监听器在被监听的值发生变化时触发，而不是在初始渲染时触发。

sents.en: Watchers fire when the watched value changes, not on initial render.
sents.zh: 监听器在被监听的值发生变化时触发，而不是在初始渲染时触发。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/vercel-labs/json-render cd json-render pnpm install pnpm dev http://json-render.localhost:1355 - Docs & Playground http://dashboard-demo.json-render.localhost:1355 - Example Dashboard http://react-email-demo.json-render.localhost:1355 - React Email Example http://remotion-demo.json-render.localhost:1355 - Remotion Video Example Chat Example: run pnpm dev in examples/chat Experimental Jev composition : use experimental_composeSpec and experimental_createEvaluator from core with your own catalog, or select Jev (Experimental) in /playground . Available since v0.21.0; pin exact package versions as described in the guide. Svelte Example: run pnpm dev in examples/svelte or examples/svelte-chat Vue Example: run pnpm dev in examples/vue Vite Renderers (React + Vue + Svelte + Solid): run pnpm dev in examples/vite-renderers React Native example: run npx expo start in examples/react-native Gaussian Splatting (R3F): run pnpm dev in examples/react-three-fiber-gsplat Gaussian Splatting (experimental standalone gsplat.js demo): run pnpm dev in examples/gsplat How It Works flowchart LR A[User Prompt] --> B[AI + Catalog] B --> C[JSON Spec] C --> D[Renderer] B -.- E([guardrailed]) C -.- F([predictable]) D -.- G([streamed]) Loading Define the guardrails - what components, actions, and data bindings AI can use Prompt - describe what you want in natural language AI generates JSON - output is always predictable, constrained to your catalog Render fast - stream and render progressively as the model responds License Apache-2.0
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/vercel-labs/json-render cd json-render pnpm install pnpm dev http://json-render.localhost:1355 - 文档与演练场 http://dashboard-demo.json-render.localhost:1355 - 仪表盘示例 http://react-email-demo.json-render.localhost:1355 - React Email 示例 http://remotion-demo.json-render.localhost:1355 - Remotion 视频示例 聊天示例：在 examples/chat 中运行 pnpm dev 实验性 Jev 组合：在 core 中使用 experimental_composeSpec 和 experimental_createEvaluator 配合你自己的目录，或在 /playground 中选择 Jev（实验性）。 自 v0.21.0 起可用；请按照指南中的说明固定精确的包版本。 Svelte 示例：在 examples/svelte 或 examples/svelte-chat 中运行 pnpm dev Vue 示例：在 examples/vue 中运行 pnpm dev Vite 渲染器（React + Vue + Svelte + Solid）：在 examples/vite-renderers 中运行 pnpm dev React Native 示例：在 examples/react-native 中运行 npx expo start 高斯泼溅（R3F）：在 examples/react-three-fiber-gsplat 中运行 pnpm dev 高斯泼溅（实验性独立 gsplat.js 演示）：在 examples/gsplat 中运行 pnpm dev 工作原理 flowchart LR A[用户提示] --> B[AI + 目录] B --> C[JSON 规范] C --> D[渲染器] B -.- E([受约束]) C -.- F([可预测]) D -.- G([流式传输]) 加载中 定义约束条件——AI 可以使用哪些组件、操作和数据绑定 提示——用自然语言描述你想要什么 AI 生成 JSON——输出始终是可预测的，且被限制在你的目录范围内 快速渲染——随着模型响应进行流式传输和渐进式渲染 许可证 Apache-2.0
